pilot.eligibility: Valid observer, forward speed>5, HUD40..80, abs(baseline steer)<=.35, gas<=.1, brake .02.. .5; no active shield/threat/recovery override. Supported common full horizon, strict upper empirical delta cost < -.05 after shared state/reference stresses and CAL residual expansion, plus supported empirical trajectory tube and unchanged .25road/.5obstacle margin vetoes. Otherwise baseline, not an inferred safe action. No requirement that all four earlier regimes qualify.
pilot.feedback: One champion query and one actual-issued-action observer commit per decision. Pure candidate calculations. Changed brake replaces current nominal brake-history item; changed steering recomputes shield actuator and box propagation from the unadvanced merged boxes, not from already propagated memory. No-op leaves champion state identical.
pilot.measurement: Completion, lap time only on finishes, progress separately, contacts/collision decisions/hit objects/damage, offroad, intervention/abstain counts and rates, failures temporally after intervention, and full successor act CPU and wall distributions. Range departures are not accidents; changing future controls are not model-error labels unless predicted with the actual sequence offline.
pilot.zero_interventions: Candidate effect NOT EVALUATED, regardless of unchanged completion or accident counts.
pilot.stop: Invalid provenance/action/feedback, execution failure or resource exhaustion preserves partial evidence without retries. Ordinary driving failures are recorded and episodes still terminate naturally. No outcome-dependent tuning or extra episode.
pilot.interpretation: Diagnostic consumed-TRAIN pilot, not safety evidence, adoption, official score or generalized superiority.
